Approach_Summary: We engineered target-free features (sensor differences, current/voltage ratio, missing-sensor flags, hard physical-range checks, and an IsolationForest anomaly score) so the pipeline works identically on unseen test data. A Random Forest classifier, trained on engineer-verified Valid/Invalid labels, learns to separate genuine operating-regime shifts from true sensor faults, rather than flagging statistical outliers alone. A second Random Forest, trained only on Valid records, predicts the Reference_Parameter. Sensor_S4 was down-weighted after EDA showed near-zero correlation with ground truth.
